name: Ironbeard's Tomb
summary: West of the road to Dun Modr, Ironbeard's Tomb lies defiled and overrun by acidic oozes. A stone statue watches over the outdoor graveyard, where travelers search the slime for lost possessions.

sections.title: A Befouled Resting Place
sections.body: Ironbeard's Tomb overlooks the marshes beside the road north to Dun Modr. A great stone statue, believed to show Ironbeard, watches over the burial plot. Black and crimson oozes have overrun the crypt below, tainting the resting place. Dwarves no longer bring their dead here. Those who enter the vaults search among the remains swallowed by the slimes.

faq.answer: Little is recorded about Ironbeard, but the statue and crypt suggest he was an honored dwarf in the Wetlands. His likeness watches over the hillside above the cemetery.
Acidic black and crimson oozes have overrun the crypt. The burial grounds are defiled and dangerous, so mourning families no longer bring their dead here.

faq.q: Why do adventurers explore Ironbeard's Tomb?
faq.answer: Travelers search the slimes for swallowed possessions, especially Sida's lost bag, while trying to fight back the infestation.

aliases: how to get to ironbeard tomb
faq.answer: Ironbeard's Tomb sits in north-central Wetlands, in a hill just west of the main road north toward Dun Modr.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing a clan hero's resting place infested by mindless marsh oozes is a bitter disgrace on the road toward the Thandol Span.
